initial_reviews.identity_verification: Manifest matches assignment; all 21 listed file hashes verified. Counts/hashes do not establish likeness.
initial_reviews.visible_gain: Body05 replaces thick blocky shoulder tiles and sparse breast strips with thinner overlapping scales. Head05 adds a swept crown and visible amber optic. Complete bird reads avian; gain is modest, not photorealism.

top_three_gaps.finding: Green head, neck and body armor reads matte, soft and swollen. Source has thin worn metal edges, fasteners, layered patina and varied specular response. Silver feet and thigh shells remain conspicuously bright/simple. Workshop light does not restore source material identity.
top_three_gaps.next_test: Rework one head-to-shoulder material/edge sample; judge unchanged neutral and workshop cameras before spreading it.

top_three_gaps.finding: Hooked bill and crest give bird identity, but broad rubberlike optic surround and flat concentric orange target lack recessed glass/hardware. Thin lower-jaw railing borders a large empty black mouth; source cheek plates, jaw machinery and swept skull form a denser connected assembly.
top_three_gaps.next_test: Match head-only cheek, brow, bill-root and recessed optic landmarks with source beside candidate, retaining stance.

top_three_gaps.finding: Source carries dense dark cylinders, collars, joints and armored toe roots through neck, flank, legs and claws. Candidate uses sparse open struts, plain joints and smooth silver toes. Regular small body scales conceal rather than reproduce the source construction hierarchy.
top_three_gaps.next_test: Review a connected neck/flank/leg region in whole-bird framing, preserving approved joint anchors.

initial_reviews.retain: Retain Body05 thinner overlap direction, compact shield silhouette and exposed flank channels; retain swept crown/hooked bill direction as a scaffold. Preserve approved stance anchors.
initial_reviews.reject_regions: Reject current soft armor finish, flat target optic and simplified cheek/jaw/foot execution as final likeness.
initial_reviews.limits: One Advanced candidate only. Camera04 35-degree fit remains an estimated hypothesis. Pose conflict awaits owner steering; no pose change recommended or claimed here. No engineering requirement applied.
initial_reviews.independence: Fresh outcome context; no worker handoffs or other QA results read. Shared model/source set can correlate agreement. No children, browser, repo edits or publication.
initial_reviews.expiry: Any artifact change or owner pose direction requires renewed matched image review.
